answer: Work must be witnessed before the dawn, because a forge cannot stamp what nobody saw. Each identity needs two holders outside its own cluster to countersign its claim, and one countersignature backs one identity, so n aliases need n distinct witnesses instead of a single ring. Every claim is priced by rank: the k-th filing an operator submits costs k squared in bond, so a farm pays near n cubed while still requiring unrelated guarantors. An audit replays a random claim each epoch, and an unconfirmed one voids the velvet seal and forfeits every bond behind it.
